page.overview:
Who is Chōchō Akimichi?

Chōchō is the only child of Karui and Chōji Akimichi. In the anime, when she was quite young, Chōchō had very high fever. Her parents worked earnestly to get a special medicine for her, which caused Chōji to trim down so much that Chōchō didn't recognise him, making her have lingering doubts about her parentage.

As her parents continued to stay close to their childhood friends over the years, Chōchō ultimately came to know the various parents' respective kids well, developing a close female friendship with Sarada Uchiha. From a young age, as fitting for the close relations between their clans, Chōchō would often have and sleepovers with Inojin and Shikadai, even having matching pyjamas. Their parents would also continue Asuma Sarutobi's tradition of taking the kids to Yakiniku Q to celebrate accomplishments.

On the day of the Seventh Hokage's inauguration, Chōchō attended the ceremony with her parents, where she ran into Sarada and her mother.

Like her father, Chōchō never turns down an invitation when it comes to food. This is evident when she skips her training with her fellow Ino–Shika–Chō members in favour of going to eat with her Academy teacher, Anko Mitarashi. Rather than feeling guilty for this, Chōchō just displayed indifference to the consequences. In stark contrast to her father, who was always quick to rile when his weight was brought up, she was initially able to easily brush off being called fat. Her weight, in fact, didn't seem to bother her at all. A few years later, however, she started to become conscious about her appearance, and would actively try to lose a few pounds, only to fail upon seeing her father's excessive eating habits and due to her own competitive nature over food, even challenging him to frequent eating contests. This, coupled with her own mother having no problem with their weight, had humorously caused Chōchō to believe she is adopted. She became impulsively convinced that any random adult she would find impressive is possibly her real parent. Ironically, upon approaching her father's slimmer form after using his Calorie Control, she approached him in the same manner and begins to develop interest for their clan's hiden jutsus.
